## Question

What precise question will this task answer?

## Assumptions and sign conventions

List mathematical, stochastic, and data assumptions. State the candidate-difference orientation.

## Evidence class

Is this theorem work, a numerical check, synthetic calibration, post-hoc analysis, or confirmatory analysis?

## Inputs and provenance

Identify permitted inputs. Frozen artifacts are read-only and must not be uploaded or committed.

## Acceptance criteria

Include deterministic commands, tests, failure behavior, and the new output namespace.

## Negative-result policy

Explain how counterexamples, negative gains, missingness, and unresolved states will be retained.
